name: verify-database-caching-performance-17
description: Puts two of lesson 17's index claims to a real PostgreSQL: that a partial index predicate calling NOW() creates a snapshot condition (it is rejected outright), and that a composite index cannot serve a query filtering on its non-leading column (this version does serve it, at a cost the plan names). Deterministic: fixed rows, no clock, no random, plan timings and buffers off.
